public_revenue_training.provider_regression_guard: Each provider validation normalized MAE may worsen no more than 2% versus seasonal naive; select smallest qualified provider-balanced normalized MAE
public_revenue_training.expert_routing_policy: Real-only phase-relative seasonal and raw harmonic residual experts; compare full already-observed 12-month revenue targets at up to three historical origins with at least 12 prior months; validation selects gain margin, no business cohort/provider labels used
public_revenue_training.validation_target: Provider-specific geographic and terminal-time validation; Uzbekistan January-December 2025 is legacy development validation
public_revenue_training.test_protocol: Fresh Eurostat six-country and whole-provider ONS audits, plus new engineering seed cohort, are constructed explicitly only after model freeze. Previous ABS/Canada, Uzbekistan and original synthetic test outcomes are consumed legacy regression benchmarks.
public_revenue_training.selection_metric: Provider-balanced macro per-history-normalized validation MAE; training loss weight equal by provider; no final test outcomes used

abs.grouping: Provider-prefixed state/province; all industry series from one geography stay together. Sector records are dependent aggregate series, not independent firms.
abs.split_algorithm: SHA256('international-region-v1:' + provider + ':' + geography), sorted; floor(0.6*n) train, half remaining validation/test
abs.quality_policy: Reject an entire case if any required history/target month is missing, suppressed, unreliable, nonfinite or negative. Published zero sales remain actual zeros; all-zero history is excluded.
abs.test_policy: Terminal test labels are imported but must not be read for training or validation selection; build test cases only after final model freeze.

public_revenue_training.temporal_scope: Holdouts are provider-local terminal years; Uzbekistan training through December 2025 overlaps some Australian/Canadian holdout dates. No absolute year, provider identity or cross-country shock covariates are features; this is not a globally chronological unseen-future test.
public_revenue_training.limitations: Original retail turnover and service value are aggregate revenue proxies, not independent firm cash receipts. Native currency units remain separate and only dimensionless errors are pooled. Survey revisions, correlated economic shocks, Uzbekistan short post-methodology histories, and cross-country aggregate-to-borrower transfer limit claims. No real costs, defaults or repayments are supplied.
public_revenue_training.selected_for_serving_by: Joint validation only: real candidate must improve provider-balanced normalized MAE at least 5% versus seasonal and each provider may regress at most 2%; then select net pooled MAE with macro/cohort guards using synthetic validation, without fitting real estimator to synthetic targets

selection.expense_training: Synthetic expense estimator fits actual generated training-business outflows only. All observation-based cost projections use only the scored borrower's past transactions; median-share projection assumes future costs scale with revenue and implicitly includes historical fixed costs. No public expense/default labels

frozen_real_component.estimator_fingerprint_scope: Exact local continuity; not required to match across platforms because floating-point fitting may differ. Cross-platform builds enforce source/data/dependency recipe continuity instead.
frozen_real_component.selection_timing: Selected on original development validation before the external revenue audit; exact fitted estimators and candidate remain fixed during net-policy reselection

policy_reselection.reason: Original guard_0.6_0.25_0.25 failed the first reserved engineering audit's majority-real requirement. Subsequent fixed50 policy and median-share12 guard75/25/25 policy each failed a cohort error guard in separate reserved audits. All three failed reports remain preserved. Original development candidates now require a tighter 10% cohort buffer and 55% mean real share, using accurate summation. No consumed audit target labels or cohort errors enter this selection; the unchanged final audit still allows 15% cohort regression. This fourth cycle is exploratory sequential development, not a fresh confirmatory experiment independent of previous aggregate rejection signals

development_net_reliability_experiments.selection_data: Original 60 development-validation businesses and already observed transaction months only; no final audit labels
development_net_reliability_experiments.comparison_scope: Frozen adaptive_revenue_10 minus observed costs versus the unchanged synthetic reference; no fitted estimators or generator changes

all_supported_origins.history_cutoffs: N-12, N-18, N-24; require at least 12 earlier observed months and 12 later already observed months
all_supported_origins.rejection: Neither local evidence rule meets the unchanged 55% development share requirement

latest_supported_origin.history_cutoff: Latest N-12 origin with at least 24 earlier observed months
latest_supported_origin.rejection: Considered but not served: extra per-request inference, 31 histories lacking supported local evidence, and slightly worse pooled development MAE than the simpler original-grid policy

selection.transfer_acceptance_gate: Selected real revenue candidate must actively use its real-data-fitted estimator; provider-balanced validation normalized MAE improves seasonal naive by at least 5%; each real provider may regress no more than 2%; downstream synthetic validation pooled MAE must improve and macro normalized MAE may worsen no more than 2%. The original 15% development cohort error guard is preserved and selection additionally requires a tighter 10% development cohort buffer. Original development mean real contribution must be at least 55%, preserving a cushion above the unchanged audit mean50 requirement. Final audit cohort tolerance remains 15%; no audit threshold is relaxed. The externally audited real component stays unchanged. No test target labels enter policy selection.
selection.transfer_selection_metric: Same 60 held-out-from-fitting synthetic validation businesses, future-12-month pooled and macro normalized net MAE; real revenue policies qualified by provider-balanced real validation first, then all fixed/observed-history-guard net policies are selected on synthetic validation only. Regime routing uses history length and the observed recent-three/prior-three inflow ratio, with no future or cohort inputs; estimators remain fitted exclusively on actual real revenue. Legacy test sets are not fresh confirmation.

public_calibration.source: Uzbekistan SIAT retail aggregate turnover, CC BY 4.0

test_protocol.interpretation: The fixed test cohort was reported before this model upgrade. It is excluded from fitting and selection, but is no longer a fresh confirmatory holdout. The external-provider final audit supplies the new real-revenue evaluation; previously reported international periods are also legacy regressions.
test_protocol.capacity_and_schedule_population: Only positive-principal businesses; zero-loan cohorts reported separately
test_protocol.overload_definition: payment > actual future net surplus; a zero payment in a negative-surplus month also counts
test_protocol.annuity_comparator: Same indexed principal, 12-month term and explicitly 0% APR; equal installments
test_protocol.mape_policy: Exclude abs(actual)<1 index. Negative actuals use absolute denominator. MAPE remains unstable near zero and is not the selection metric.

seasonality.ground_truth: Future realised net-flow bottom/top quartiles, not generator seasonal parameters

max_20000_transaction_request.construction: Repeated generated synthetic transaction events; latency-only, not a capacity accuracy test

latency.scope: Single process, warm model, sequential local TestClient. Includes JSON validation, response serialization and durable audit; excludes network/load and train/startup.
